newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.70 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +2.70 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.259 to the dollar after Wednesday's fixing at 27.311 and at 17.651 to the mark from 17.689.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +2.70 percent, up from Wednesday's +2.50.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown traded on the interbank market at +2.64 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
